title: Protocol for Dissociation and Culture of Midbrain Astrocytes and Neurons
author: Elena Coccia
materials: Gently pipette up and down to dissociate cells.
Neutralize with 10 mL of complete medium.

steps.title: Dissociate and harvest midbrain astrocytes
steps.instruction: Dissociate midbrain astrocyte culture using TrypLE Select.

substeps.instruction: Add TrypLE Select to the midbrain astrocyte culture.
Gently pipette up and down to dissociate cells.
Neutralize with 10 mL of complete medium.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Add Accutase to the neuron culture.
Gently pipette up and down to dissociate cells.
Neutralize with 10 mL of complete medium.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Pool cells and embed in Geltrex
steps.instruction: Combine the dissociated astrocytes and neurons and embed them in Geltrex for plating.

substeps.instruction: Combine resuspended astrocytes and neurons at a 5:1 ratio (100,000 neurons to 20,000 astrocytes).
Mix gently and spin down again.
Remove supernatant and resuspend into Geltrex supplemented with 10µM of Y-27632, 10ng/ml CNTF, 20ng/ml BDNF, and 20ng/ml GFNF.
Aliquot 5 µL droplets into each well of a black 96-well plate.
Allow droplets to polymerize at 37°C for 10 minutes.
Fill each well with 100 µL of neuronal differentiation media supplemented with 10 ng/mL CNTF.
